packages.name: ouncefin
packages.title: Ouncefin
packages.author: dragonflylee and Souldbminer
packages.details:
Ouncefin is a free and open source Jellyfin client for the Nintendo Switch 2.

It supports various features, including downloads, hardware accellerated decoding, mouse mode and more!

packages.name: openrct2-switch
packages.title: OpenRCT2
packages.author: OpenRCT2
packages.description: An open source theme-park management game.
packages.details:
OpenRCT2 is a open source reimplementation of the RollerCoaster Tycoon series. 
It requires your own game files placed in sdmc:/switch/openrct2/
This port supports various features including High-Res, Mouse mode, and more!.
